name: The Great Tree Provides
objectiveText: Collect 6 Dewy Lasher Fronds , an Empty Vial , and a Refreshing Spring Water for Byancie in Dolanaar. Dewy Lasher Frond  ( 6 ) Empty Vial  ( 1 ) Refreshing Spring Water  ( 1 )

comments.body:
Empty Vial: acquire 2nd level of tree above the quest giver.
Refreshing Spring Water: acquire at the Innkeeper across the road.
Dewey Lasher Fronds: Kill Lasher Sproutlings south of Dolanaar

As a Druid this quest is a bit of a pain...  The lashers are immune to Wrath, and at this level we have 2 real damaging abilities - Wrath and Moonfire. Can however recommend not trying to kill the ones by Wellspring Lake (the water to the North) - but instead go for the lower level ones south of Dolanaar. You're still going to have to Moonfire them down though, kite a little. But around lvl 10 it's doable.
replies: Found this out during the stress test. So annoying for a druid and the drop rate for the Lasher Fronds was abysmal. I honestly don't think it's worth doing as a druid, too much time spent for only xp.
